summary: Round 1, exhaustive, scoped to the requester-approved minimal stub. All four checks hold: it states it is a CHG-0004 audit-only placeholder changing no architecture (consistent with REQ-A11Y-010 AC-3 and the out-of-scope list); its pointers to CHG-0001 README views, sdd.md section 2 (Components) and section 11 (Local run) are accurate and nothing is copied; the Pending section names CHG-0005 (PR #7, frozen, parked until M22), native-run and Compose views, second-merger reconciliation and CHG-0005 as intended content; it adds no element a later SDD could build on. Two follow-ups (1 minor, 1 info).

findings.message: The stub says each CHG-0001 view is a .drawio source with a PNG and a PDF export beside it; the README links the exports in png/ and pdf/ subfolders, not beside the source.
findings.suggestion: Say the PNG and PDF exports are under png/ and pdf/ of that folder (README rows 1-10).

findings.message: The stub calls CHG-0001 diagrams the as-built architecture; the README says they were drawn against CHG-0001 frozen spec (design), not checked against the built code.
findings.suggestion: Optionally say the architecture of record (as designed in CHG-0001 frozen spec); moot once CHG-0005 replaces the file.
